UFO's vs Airlines: Are UFOs a threat to civil aviation? The culture of silence within the aviation industry could speak volumes. (5 of 6)
Shoot 'Em Down: Fighter pilots from the UK to Peru have encountered UFOs. What happens when a UFO gets too close for comfort? (6 of 6)

items.sum: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

Isabella. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Zena Walker, Helen Cherry & Donald Pleasence. Princess Avice summons Robin for help after discovering her husband is planning to marry a French princess.
The Sunken Temple. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Greydon Gould. Despite warnings from locals, the Supercar team explore an underwater temple only to find out why they were warned.
Man in Demand. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dorothy Gordon & Enid Lorimer. A young wife finds her marriage in danger due to her mother in law's excessive demands on her son.

1951. Drama. Stars Bonar Colleano, Barbara Kelly, Eva Bartok & Gina Lollobrigida. An Englishman leaves America to enlist in the RAF, but a drunken accident results in a loss of memory.
Legacy. 1975. Stars Lois Baxter, Lynda Bellingham & Frederick Jaeger. The hunt for Skinner's murderer has moved away from Newtown. So why is a London detective on his way there, in secret?

Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November.
The Crown Jewels. 1963 Stars Dermot Walsh, Maurice Kaufmann & Lisa Daniely. A young knight is in debt to a gambling den. They threaten him and try to convince him to help steal the crown jewels.
1949. Drama. Directors Michael Powell, Emeric Pressburger. Stars David Farrar, Jack Hawkins and Kathleen Byron. The best bomb disposal expert must battle his inner self, during the German raids.
1953. War. Directed by Charles Frend. Stars Jack Hawkins, Donald Sinden & Denholm Elliott. The dramatic story of a British convoy escort ship and its novice crew who set out to save lives.
The Thunderbirds team provide information and statistics on road traffic accidents and provide some safety tips for children.
1965. The Hidden Face. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Pamela Abbott. When a member of parliament takes his own life, his son seeks the author of the book that triggered the tragedy. (S1, E08)
Take a glorious trip back to Lancashire in 1948... to celebrate bleach, then let's cycle back to the 50s, and remember to bring your wheelbarrows - there's a new way to make a bob or two!
The Vanishing M. Owen. 1997. Stars Bruno Cremer, Arielle Dombasle & Bernard Haller. Whilst on holiday in Cannes, Maigret receives news a man has drowned in the bath in the suite of M. Ernst Owen.

items.t: What Ever Happened To Aunt Alice
items.sum: 1969. Drama. Directed by Lee H. Katzin. Stars Ruth Gordon, Geraldine Page & Robert Fuller. Alice applies for the job of housekeeper in order to find out what happened to a missing widowed friend.
Murders on Aix Island - Les Mystères de l¿île. 2016. Director: François Guérin. Stars Julie Ferrier & Isabel Otero. Police investigate the murder of a former convict found dead near Fort Boyard.

(1955) Classic western with Randolph Scott and Forrest Tucker. When the notorious Reno Brothers start rampaging through the west, a special agent is sent to bring them to justice.
(1955) Suspenseful western with Chill Wills, Lance Fuller and Cathy Downs. When a gun-filled wagon breaks down in enemy territory, will its occupants surrender their cargo or fight for their lives?
(1947) Western with the legendary John Wayne. A wounded gunslinger is taken in by a Quaker girl, who inspires him to give up his old ways - until his past catches up with him and puts her in danger.
(1946) Western with Randolph Scott, Edgar Buchanan and Lloyd Bridges. As tensions build between unruly cattlemen and determined homesteaders in post-Civil War Kansas, can one man keep the peace?
(2020) Suspenseful thriller starring Andrea Bogart. When her daughter is abducted, Shannon decides to take matters into her own hands, putting her on a collision course with a deadly kidnapper...

(2015) Obsessive drama with Mia Rose Frampton. A troubled high school student meets a teacher who offers to help her avoid probation, but her methods prove unethical, disturbing and ultimately deadly.

(2020) Twist-laden thriller with Annie Heise. To escape her past, Taylor becomes an au pair for a wealthy family. But scratching the surface of their perfect world will reveal some very dark secrets..
(1986) Explosive 80s action with Rutger Hauer and Gene Simmons. Business is booming for legendary bounty hunter Nick Randall - but there will be hell to pay when the CIA turn this hunter into prey...
(2010) Sci-fi action adventure starring Kari Matchett. An astronomer works to save the city of San Francisco from total annihilation when a once-in-a-lifetime celestial event turns into a nightmare.

Laura Hamilton helps Nikki and her mum Rosaline find the perfect holiday home with bags of character and a pool, in the medieval town of Sarlat in France, for Nikki's budget of £250k.
Pauline and her son Robert look for a holiday home on the northern Costa Blanca for £275k, from a budget buster that makes a splash to a spacious doer-upper. Are any of them the right fit?

The World Wide Spider. Danger Mouse has to face his only fear when Penfold accidentally awakens a gigantic World Wide Spider.
The Big Birch Bird. Much to Trevor's irritation, a rare phoenix woodpecker takes a liking to him - so he demands an immediate quest to return the bird to its real home.

Substitute Egg. Grizzy and the Lemmings attempt to take back a chocolate egg from a group of penguins.
The Check-Up. Mr Krabs is too scared to get his physical.
Day Off. Duck gets a rare day off and heads for a day at the spa. But once he sees that Frog is working there, he finds it impossible to relax.
Pizza. Duck has to deliver pizzas around the town, but he hasn't reckoned with the lengths that Frog will go to to get them all for himself.
The Triangle Cafe . Ozzie and Orli go on a mission to catch the villain who is ruining the Triangle Sisters' cafe.
We Could Actually Stop Climate Change? The planet is being destroyed - but this episode demonstrates the things you can do to help save it.
...Olds: English - Writing Poetry. Using vocabulary to entertain, identifying the structure of a poem, and writing in the style of Joshua Seigal.
Episode 5. Historical sketch show. Famous monk St Augustine struggles to introduce Christianity to Saxon England, and Stuart diarist Samuel Pepys annoys the smartest men in Britain.
Brazil. A helicopter trip over Brazil's northern savannah helps adventurer Steve Backshall find his next contender for the Deadly 60, the elusive giant anteater.
Super Saliva. The doctors reveal how amazing your saliva is, and they find out why the hospital's maintenance team work with birds of prey.
Illusion Skills. Ricky makes art in nine minutes. Not everything is as it seems, as the Grand Master makes art that colours itself. Ricky makes a silhouette look 3D.
Join Abby Cook, Rhys Stephenson and Gladiator Diamond for a nationwide Upstander Uproar as we break the silence around bullying in the loudest way possible.
You Could Fly Like a Bird? Anyone can fly like a bird - you just have to travel across the solar system to do it!
Cracking Egg Tortilla. Buddy and Jaylen make tortilla wraps with salsa for their plates and on the dance floor.
Euro Zoo. The brothers go to work at an awesome German zoo. Tyler discovers the wonders of the rainforest, Aaron goes ape with orangutans, and Cam makes a splash at an elephant pool party!
(Boarding) School of Rock. While classical music is a part of everyday life at the boarding school, Queen fan Ella wants to turn the volume up by starting the school's first rock band.
BFFs. Best mates Riley and Maddie battle a boys' team, and pals Masai and Ernest swap the pitch for the kitchen. Michael Dawson is in Skill Showdown.
The Whale Shark. Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his band of explorers. Dashi is swallowed by a whale shark so the Octonauts venture inside to rescue her.
When We Lost D.O.R.I.S.'s Brain. A creature takes D.O.R.I.S.'s brain, so Cosima and Big Lizard chase it into the forest.
Penguin Games. When Millie the Squid devises a set of tough penguin games to test the Piripenguins, Pancake and Nugget must stick together and rely on their friendship to succeed.
Vanish. After Wizz loses a bike, everything around him begins to disappear into thin air.
Punting. Duck has a job punting tourists along the waterways, but Frog thinks he can do it better.

items.t: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese
items.sum: Safety Dance. Boy trains the family after realising that they don't have a safety drill for emergencies.
The Plague. Cammy accidentally starts a rumour. Damian challenges Layla. Melody tries to catch a cold.
The Competition. Dancer Jakob has trained so hard to earn a place at one of the world's most prestigious international ballet competitions - but will his hard work be worth it?
Viral Video With Dr O. Olympia interviews Dr O and learns about odd viruses.
Treasure Hunt. When Bitzer can't find his buried bone, it's up to Shaun and the flock to try and find it - but X doesn't always mark the spot.
The Beat Goes On. Rubi's dance machine gets muddled up with Crusty the Robot Pie's coding.
Never Say Clever Again. Animated series. When all the other danger agents become supersmart due to a batch of genetically enhanced celery, Danger Mouse might need to find a new job.
Snow Day. When the heroes wake up on Snow Day morning, there isn't a snowflake in sight! The heroes must quest to free the Snow Dragon and save Snow Day for all.

items.t: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese

items.sum: Evil Spirit. The Lemmings decide to free a spirit and send it to Grizzy.
Library. Duck becomes a very serious librarian and makes it his mission to maintain the peace and quiet - that is until Frog arrives and has other ideas.
Looping Monster. When Pablo gets excited about going to the lake after lunch and seeing ducklings, he is visited by a looping monster and can't think about anything else at all.
Ticklebeast. Meet the ancient, interdimensional curse known as Ticklebeast. Don't say it three times.
Episode 6. Roland talks absolute rubbish, a helpful zombie tries cooking, and a fly puts on trousers.
I Put a Hex on You! The Hex Girls need Mystery, Inc for a cursed guitar.
The Case of the Puppet Master. The Witch Detectives uncover a villain mind-controlling citizens into crime.
Gumbearable. Owen accidentally swallows a piece of gum.
Escape the Island. Adam and Joe battle to escape Sharky Shores, before racing through a mind-boggling maze and action-packed cave to bring water to Quackius Maximus!
Anti-Bullying Special: Come Together. Riley helps the team get ready for competition by doing anti-bullying exercises.
Nina Simone. Tabitha tells the story of singer-songwriter and civil rights activist Nina Simone.

items.t: Pudsey and the Thread of Hope
items.sum: Join Pudsey Bear as he takes nine-year-old Jai on a magical adventure of hope and joy.
This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
Dew. It's time for school. The Nogglins find a tiny moon. Itty plays a trick that scares Fidd, who makes a discovery that amazes the Nogglins.
Cranberry. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the bouncing and singing Cranberries!
Big Boots. Children's animation. Bing and Sula are in the park playing at being giants and splashing in puddles with their big boots.
Sing Song. Preschool series. Laa-Laa makes up a lovely song and sings with the other Teletubbies. A children's choir sings in Tummy Tales.
Need a Carry. Tee's a growing monkey and is getting quite heavy, however some days he just wants to be carried - all day.
Black and White. Black and White arrive in Colourland. Learn about two colours that are very different from the other Colourblocks.
Drums. Bingo is in the music shop with Mum when she discovers an electronic drum kit.
Hose Pipe. Bing turns the garden hose on too fast, converting it into a big out-of-control snake!
Big Top Bo. Tao can't go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo's tops!
The Ball Badge. The Squirrels are confused when they see Duggee sitting on a ball because they all have their own favourite way of using it, whether it be kicking, throwing or catching.
The News Badge. After learning that Duggee is making his yearly batch of blueberry jam, a tradition passed on from his great-aunt, the Squirrels decide to spread the news.
Mini Bluey. Dad whinges that Bluey and Bingo are too different, so Bluey plans to make them more alike.
Duck Cake. Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingo's birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys.
Singapore. Kym takes on her first challenge in Singapore to win the Go Jetters Cup. She must stop Glitch from destroying the famous Merlion to earn her first G.O. Star.
The Tale of the Fierce Bad Rabbit. Animated series. Peter and his friends set out to taste the sweetest dandelions, only to find that they're protected by a mean character!
The Tsunami. A tsunami washes some sea creatures inland; the Octonauts trek into the forest to help.
How Many Smoothies? Five's new smoothie café is open! Can the Numberblocks get the orders right?
Meet Gold and Silver. Meet Gold and Silver who sparkle and shine! Blue discovers these new friends who show him just what they can do with their exciting, shiny colours.
Dress Up Day. Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny create their own superhero and supervillain characters for Dress Up Day, but their fun threatens to ruin the day for everyone else.
The Jam Session. Robert, Little Monster, Cat and Cherry get a chance to audition to join YolanDa and her house band, but when YolanDa arrives, they all get too nervous to play!

items.t: Hey Duggee: Top of the Pups
items.sum: The Shapes Song. Throw some shapes with King Tiger. What will yours be? Square, triangle, circle, hexagon, heptagon...?
Bus Ride. The seaside bus breaks down, but Bing still finds a way to have fun.
Flower. Dee encourages a friend to say 'flower', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a pink flower, a yellow flower, a frilly flower and silly squirty flowers too!
Quiet Moments. Tralala finds the house too noisy until she joins the dust bunnies' rock band.
Mae, Bee and the Oak Knot Door. A magical key unlocks a door to some giant-sized fun.
Sugar. Lou eats too much sugar and runs amok at a poetry recital.
On and Off. Stop-motion preschool series. A sunbather tries to keep his sun hat on, while the Twirlywoos keep taking it off! The Very Important Lady visits the boat.
New Shoes. Educational series using Makaton sign language. Today, Justin goes shoe shopping. Mr Tumble visits Shopkeeper Tumble at The Shop with the Lot for pair of new red boots!
Up High. Preschool series. The Teletubbies bounce on the Tubby Bouncy. Po bounces as high as a cloud, then Laa-Laa and Dipsy bounce higher and Tinky Winky bounces highest of all.
Orange. Nigel and Baby Bear invite babies and their grown-ups to explore oranges through discovery, play, song and story. Babies and grown-ups at home can join in too!
Wind Farm Beach. Elsee plays I-spy whilst on a beach walk with Mohamoud.
Maddie's Tree. While helping Nana prune Mum's tree, Maddie is shocked to learn that this means cutting off all its branches! But, as always, Dado has a few crafty surprises up his sleeve.
Rebecca's Pet Plant. Stan the plant inspires some jungle animal makes in the attic. A plastic bottle becomes a tropical bug, and an egg box becomes a snippy snappy crocodile.
Jungle Jiggles. Stop-frame animation featuring Raa Raa, who lives in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa wants a partner for a noisy stompy dance.
Camping. While away camping, Bluey makes a new friend called Jean-Luc. Despite speaking different languages, they come up with a great game.
The Topiary Badge. After seeing Duggee's topiary skills, the Squirrels are keen to try it out for themselves.

items.t: Chantelle and Rory's Teeny Tiny Creatures
items.sum: Prawns. Chantelle and friends look for prawns in the rock pools, whilst Rory heads to the harbour.
Meet Eden and Ava's Family. Eden and Ava set up a beauty salon and make their very own face mask mixture. Dad pops along for a beauty treatment, but will his visit leave him feeling relaxed?
Cinderella and her Slippers. Jen and Small are off to a disco, but they need to finish dusting before they can go.
Mission: Train Station. Guide dog Kika must use her supersight to help Dr Amit catch a train to the city.
Giant Chinese Salamander and Alaotran Gentle Lemur. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Chinese giant salamanders and Alaotran gentle lemurs.
Midwife. Midwife Marley shows us how her foetal heart scanner can pick up the sound that a baby's heart makes inside its mummy's tummy.
Waffle's Bouncy Castle. Pepper arrives, and the after schoolers help Waffle join in with some bouncy castle fun.
Bernie's Shell. Bernie needs a new shell. Oona and Silky find him the perfect replacement.
Sunrise. Stripes and Toad want to write a song together, but they fall out. Can Yukee help them?
Cupcake Surprise. Lu learns that she can't be upset with someone for doing something she has also done.
Sitting Pretty. The Piggies build a relaxing bench for Brian, but Wilf makes it wild!
Once Upon a Time. Children's animation. Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about the first five Numberblocks.
Web. The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. W wants to be a superhero, but saving Alphablocks is not as easy as it looks.
Tea Party. Ben meets his friends in the kitchen for some baking fun, while Mr Tumble gets ready for a party.
Songtime. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po enjoy Tiddlytubbies Songtime. Then it is time for Teletubbies Songtime. The Teletubbies sing solo before singing all together.
Hedges. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on an eco quest to find out all about hedges.
Train Tracks and Paint. Maddie learns how train tracks and signal boxes work and visits a factory where coloured paint is made.
Forestry Machines. CBeebies' motorbike rider Grace shows off three machines used in sustainable forests.
Miss Gerrard's Birthday. It's Miss Gerrard's birthday, and the children plan a surprise party for her.
Mimic Octopus. Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his explorers. The Octonauts recruit a shape-shifting mimic octopus to help them on a mission.
The Tale of the Radish Robber. Animated series. Peter and his friends try to find the perfect place to eat the radishes they took from Mr McGregor's garden.
The Big Day Out Badge. Duggee takes the Squirrels and their parents on an exciting mystery trip.
Big Sister Nugget. Nugget plays big sister to a kid penguin for the summer. But when her hyper-energetic plans for fun activities prove unpopular, Pancake suggests an alternative approach.
Peas and Quiet. Supertato and Carrot investigate strange noises in the middle of the night.
Mission Wake Up. On the Ducklings' activity day, Weasy is too tired to play. Can he find a way to wake up?
Super Secret Swoptops. It's secret agent time when Mojo and Bo think Didi the tractor is up to something fishy. But can the two super secret spies follow her without being spotted?
Mini Bluey. Dad whinges that Bluey and Bingo are too different, so Bluey plans to make them more alike.
Duck Cake. Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingo's birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys.
Substitute Dragon. Zog and the doctors become teachers for the day, looking after the little dragons.
Volcano Mix-Up. PC Plum jumps to conclusions when he hears about a volcanic eruption in Balamory.
Waffle Misses Doug. Preschool comedy drama series. Doug's mum Zoe brings surprises for the Brooklyn-Bells, but Waffle is sad because Doug is going to stay with her for a few days.
The Breakfast Wish. Rafi's breakfast wish causes kitchen chaos when she wakes up early to surprise her dads.
It's Time for Autumn Leaves. JoJo needs to find different-coloured leaves to complete her nature tick-book, but she can't find a green one. What will she do?
Tapping Shoes. Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures. Sarah needs some new shoes, but picks out a very unusual pair.
